title: Policy ownership and periodic review
requirement: Policies have a named owner, are formally approved, and are reviewed regularly.
look_for: A named policy owner or approver, an effective or approval date, and a review cycle of at least once a year.
evidence_needed: Approved policy with version history, owner sign-off and last review date

title: Unique IDs and strong authentication
requirement: Every user has a unique ID and authenticates with strong credentials.
look_for: Unique user IDs with no shared accounts, AND strong password rules (length of 12+ or complexity), AND account lockout after repeated failed logins.
evidence_needed: Identity provider export of user list; password and lockout configuration screenshot

title: Access approved before it is granted
requirement: Access is formally requested and approved before it is provisioned.
look_for: A documented request process (e.g., ticket) AND approval by a manager or system owner before access is granted.
evidence_needed: Sample of access request tickets showing manager approval before access was granted

title: Timely removal of access
requirement: Access is removed promptly when a user leaves or changes role.
look_for: Access removed within a defined timeframe (e.g., 24 hours) on termination, covering employees AND contractors, AND access adjusted when a user changes role.
evidence_needed: List of leavers vs. account disable dates showing removal within the SLA

title: Least privilege and role-based access
requirement: Users receive only the access their job role requires.
look_for: A least-privilege principle AND role-based access (groups or roles) AND restriction of administrator rights.
evidence_needed: Role/group matrix and list of admin users with justification

title: Periodic user access reviews
requirement: User access is reviewed on a regular schedule and inappropriate access is removed.
look_for: User access reviews at a defined frequency (e.g., quarterly), performed by system owners or managers, with evidence retained.
evidence_needed: Signed quarterly access review records with actions taken

title: MFA for remote and external access
requirement: Multi-factor authentication protects remote and external access.
look_for: MFA required for ALL remote access (VPN, cloud consoles, external apps) for ALL users, not only administrators.
evidence_needed: MFA enforcement settings for VPN, cloud console and SSO

title: Access activity logged and monitored
requirement: Security-relevant access events are logged and monitored for anomalies.
look_for: Logging of logins, failed login attempts and privileged actions, AND regular review or alerting on those logs.
evidence_needed: Log retention settings, sample alerts and evidence of log review

title: Encryption in transit
requirement: Data transmitted over networks is encrypted.
look_for: Use of TLS/HTTPS or equivalent encryption for data in transit, especially over public networks.
evidence_needed: TLS configuration or SSL scan results for public endpoints

title: Encryption at rest
requirement: Sensitive data stored in systems is encrypted.
look_for: Encryption of stored data (databases, disks, backups, laptops) with managed encryption keys.
evidence_needed: Encryption settings for databases, disks and backups; key management records

title: Incident response process
requirement: Security incidents are reported, contained, resolved and reviewed under a defined process.
look_for: A documented incident response process with roles, reporting steps, containment, communication and post-incident review.
evidence_needed: Incident response plan, incident log and a post-incident review

title: Change management
requirement: Changes to systems are authorized, tested and approved before release.
look_for: Change requests that are documented, tested, approved before production deployment, with segregation between developer and approver.
evidence_needed: Sample of change tickets with testing evidence and approvals

title: Vendor risk management
requirement: Risks from vendors and third parties are assessed and monitored.
look_for: Security assessment of vendors before onboarding, contracts with security requirements, and periodic vendor review.
evidence_needed: Vendor inventory, vendor risk assessments and security clauses in contracts

title: Risk assessment
requirement: Risks to objectives are identified and assessed regularly.
look_for: A risk assessment performed at least annually, with identified risks, ratings and treatment plans.
evidence_needed: Latest risk assessment and risk register with treatment plans

title: Security awareness and policy acknowledgement
requirement: Personnel are trained on security and acknowledge policies.
look_for: Security awareness training at onboarding and at least annually, AND personnel acknowledgement of policies.
evidence_needed: Training completion records and signed policy acknowledgements

title: Backups and recovery
requirement: Data is backed up and recovery is tested.
look_for: Regular backups, defined retention, and periodic restore testing or a tested recovery plan.
evidence_needed: Backup job reports and a restore test record
